evidence.text:
git add -A && git commit -m "Fix templar overrides to ignore None, improve lookup error messaging, make timedout test strictly boolean, and align legacy YAML types constructors with base types.

- Templar.copy_with_new_env and set_temporary_context now ignore None in overrides
- Lookup errors under errors: warn/ignore now include exception type and are log-only for ignore
- timedout test plugin returns a strict boolean based on 'period'
- _AnsibleMapping/_AnsibleUnicode/_AnsibleSequence mirror base constructors (including no-arg and object/bytes+encoding)
- CLI fatal error print includes help text when available

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>"
